ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First read out the constraint conditions: x+2y-4≤0, that is, x+2y≤4, and x≥0, y≥0. Therefore the feasible region is the triangular region in the first quadrant enclosed by the line x+2y=4 and the coordinate axes, with vertices (0,0), (4,0), (0,2). Rewrite and understand z=(y+2)/(x-1) as a slope: if the fixed point P=(1,-2) is taken, and Q=(x,y) is a point in the feasible region, then the slope of the line PQ is (y-(-2))/(x-1)=(y+2)/(x-1), namely z. Note that when x=1, the expression is undefined. Examine the range of slopes of lines passing through P and intersecting the triangular feasible region. When the feasible point is in the part x<1, because y≥0, so y+2>0, while x-1<0, therefore z<0. The boundary of negative slopes can be given by the point (0,0): z=(0+2)/(0-1)=-2. When x approaches 1 from the left, that is, x→1^-, the denominator x-1→0^-, while the numerator y+2>0, so z→-∞. Therefore the negative-value part is (-∞,-2]. When the feasible point is in the part x>1, because y+2>0, x-1>0, so z>0. The minimum boundary of positive slopes is given by the point (4,0): z=(0+2)/(4-1)=2/3. When x approaches 1 from the right, that is, x→1^+, the denominator x-1→0^+, the numerator y+2>0, so z→+∞. Therefore the positive-value part is [2/3,+∞). Combining the two parts, the range of values of z is (-∞,-2]∪[2/3,+∞).

method.method_draft: 几何斜率法：先从题面读出可行域约束 x+2y-4≤0, x≥0, y≥0，它在平面上是三角形区域，顶点为 (0,0)、(4,0)、(0,2)。再把 z=(y+2)/(x-1) 解释为连接固定点 P=(1,-2) 与可行域内点 Q=(x,y) 的直线斜率，注意 x=1 时表达式无定义。考察过 P 且与三角形相交的直线斜率范围：在左侧 x<1 的可行点给出负斜率，极大负斜率边界由 Q=(0,0) 得 z=-2，靠近 x=1^- 时斜率趋于 -∞，所以得到 (-∞,-2]；在右侧 x>1 的可行点给出正斜率，最小正斜率由 Q=(4,0) 得 z=2/3，靠近 x=1^+ 时斜率趋于 +∞，所以得到 [2/3,+∞)。合并得到取值范围。
method.CoT_raw:
先读出约束条件：x+2y-4≤0，即 x+2y≤4，且 x≥0，y≥0。因此可行域是在第一象限内由直线 x+2y=4 与坐标轴围成的三角形区域，顶点为 (0,0)、(4,0)、(0,2)。

把 z=(y+2)/(x-1) 改写理解为斜率：若取固定点 P=(1,-2)，可行域内点 Q=(x,y)，则直线 PQ 的斜率为 (y-(-2))/(x-1)=(y+2)/(x-1)，即 z。注意当 x=1 时，表达式无定义。

考察过 P 且与三角形可行域相交的直线斜率范围。

当可行点在 x<1 的部分时，因为 y≥0，所以 y+2>0，而 x-1<0，因此 z<0。负斜率的边界可由点 (0,0) 给出：z=(0+2)/(0-1)=-2。当 x 从左侧趋近 1，即 x→1^- 时，分母 x-1→0^-，而分子 y+2>0，所以 z→-∞。因此负值部分为 (-∞,-2]。

当可行点在 x>1 的部分时，因为 y+2>0，x-1>0，所以 z>0。正斜率的最小边界由点 (4,0) 给出：z=(0+2)/(4-1)=2/3。当 x 从右侧趋近 1，即 x→1^+ 时，分母 x-1→0^+，分子 y+2>0，所以 z→+∞。因此正值部分为 [2/3,+∞)。

合并两部分，z 的取值范围为 (-∞,-2]∪[2/3,+∞)。

1. 当 0≤x<1 时，x-1<0，而 y+2≥2>0，所以 z<0。固定 x 时，分母为负，z=(y+2)/(x-1) 随 y 增大而减小，因此最大值在 y=0 时取得，即 z=2/(x-1)。当 x∈[0,1) 时，2/(x-1) 从 -2 开始，并在 x→1^- 时趋于 -∞，所以负值部分为 (-∞,-2]。

2. 当 1<x≤4 时，x-1>0。固定 x 时，z=(y+2)/(x-1) 随 y 增大而增大，因此最小值在 y=0 时取得，即 z=2/(x-1)。当 x∈(1,4] 时，2/(x-1) 从 +∞ 下降到 2/3，所以正值部分为 [2/3,+∞)。

Rewrite and understand z=(y+2)/(x-1) as a slope: if the fixed point P=(1,-2) is taken, and Q=(x,y) is a point in the feasible region, then the slope of the line PQ is (y-(-2))/(x-1)=(y+2)/(x-1), namely z. Note that when x=1, the expression is undefined.

Examine the range of slopes of lines passing through P and intersecting the triangular feasible region.

When the feasible point is in the part x<1, because y≥0, so y+2>0, while x-1<0, therefore z<0. The boundary of negative slopes can be given by the point (0,0): z=(0+2)/(0-1)=-2. When x approaches 1 from the left, that is, x→1^-, the denominator x-1→0^-, while the numerator y+2>0, so z→-∞. Therefore the negative-value part is (-∞,-2].

When the feasible point is in the part x>1, because y+2>0, x-1>0, so z>0. The minimum boundary of positive slopes is given by the point (4,0): z=(0+2)/(4-1)=2/3. When x approaches 1 from the right, that is, x→1^+, the denominator x-1→0^+, the numerator y+2>0, so z→+∞. Therefore the positive-value part is [2/3,+∞).

Combining the two parts, the range of values of z is (-∞,-2]∪[2/3,+∞).
